person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages repeatedly show external third-person narration with free-indirect access to Evvie and, at times, another character. First-person and second-person forms in the quote set are dialogue, therapeutic reflections, or universal maxims rather than autonomous narrative sections. A publisher-hosted opening excerpt independently confirms third-person narration, and the whole-book structural source explicitly describes the novel as mainly Evvie-limited third person with occasional shifts of focal character. No credible source indicates a sustained change of grammatical person; the only limitation is that the authorized prose evidence is opening-scoped, resolved by the whole-book analysis and corroborating interior quotes.
